one site, no saving, and a named reason instead of a quiet omission

containers.note: the discovery half's projection: pool metadata and the reserves restated from logs. §4 of M8.4.3's own text forbids reading it as REVM canonical state, and it is not a carrier for any of the 78 measured pairs — nothing in it is handed to a later stage's read.
a projection with a block number and no block hash, so it cannot even show which block it describes; the same §4 boundary applies.
the *claim* that travels from detection to the stages that check it. It carries reserves as data to be re-read, not as an answer to be served.
one stage's own gathering: it does not cross a boundary, which is why a candidate that wanted it to needs a new carrier.
the only type that crosses Preflight → Build today, and it has no block field — M8.4.3 names this as the missing carrier for a header answer.
M8.4.4's contract: produced by a verified read, checked again by the consumer, and measured to save no RPC, because the consumer's read replaces nothing.

the transaction being built holds its own fee fields. §10 named an ExecutionIntent: no such type exists in this workspace (see the searched-and-absent row), and this is the type that carries the fields it was asking about.
a height and a hash, carried from the observation stage and checked by the simulation's own header read.
M8.3.1's real cache, and the reason no REVM-side read appears in the census as an avoidable duplicate: its scope is one simulation, which is what its own documentation says.
the connection, which holds the chain id from connect to drop. The census's only proven owner-and-scope pair — and still a safe saving of 0, because the later asks are each a named leg of a check.
